verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: الٓرٰ ۟ تِلۡکَ اٰیٰتُ الۡکِتٰبِ وَقُرۡاٰنٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: Alif Lam Ra[✛]. These are verses of the Book and of the illuminating Qur’an.

verses.ar: رُبَمَا یَوَدُّ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا لَوۡ کَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِیۡنَ ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: Often will the disbelievers wish that they were Muslims.

verses.ar: ذَرۡہُمۡ یَاۡکُلُوۡا وَیَتَمَتَّعُوۡا وَیُلۡہِہِمُ الۡاَمَلُ فَسَوۡفَ یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: Leave them alone that they may eat and enjoy themselves and that vain hope may beguile them; but they will soon know.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَہۡلَکۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡیَۃٍ اِلَّا وَلَہَا کِتَابٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: And We have never destroyed any town but there was for it a known decree.

verses.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّۃٍ اَجَلَہَا وَمَا یَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: No people can outstrip their appointed time, nor can they remain behind.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا یٰۤاَیُّہَا الَّذِیۡ نُزِّلَ عَلَیۡہِ الذِّکۡرُ اِنَّکَ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ ؕ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: And they said, ‘O thou to whom this Exhortation has been sent down, thou art surely a madman.

verses.ar: لَوۡ مَا تَاۡتِیۡنَا بِالۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃِ اِنۡ کُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: ‘Why dost thou not bring angels to us, if thou art of the truthful?’

verses.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَمَا کَانُوۡۤا اِذًا مُّنۡظَرِیۡنَ ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: We do not send down angels but by due right, and then they are granted no respite.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّکۡرَ وَاِنَّا لَہٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: Verily, We Ourself have sent down this Exhortation, and most surely We will be its Guardian.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِکَ فِیۡ شِیَعِ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We sent Messengers before thee among parties of ancient peoples.

verses.ar: وَمَا یَاۡتِیۡہِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا کَانُوۡا بِہٖ یَسۡتَہۡزِءُوۡنَ ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: And there never came to them any Messenger but they mocked at him.

verses.ar: کَذٰلِکَ نَسۡلُکُہٗ فِیۡ قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۳﴾
verses.en: Thus do We cause this habit of mocking to enter into the hearts of the sinful people;
w: do We cause this habit of mocking to enter

verses.ar: لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِہٖ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّۃُ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿۱۴﴾
verses.en: They believe not therein, though the example of the former peoples has gone before them.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوۡا فِیۡہِ یَعۡرُجُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۵﴾
verses.en: And even if We opened to them a door from heaven, and they began ascending through it,

verses.ar: لَقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّمَا سُکِّرَتۡ اَبۡصَارُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٌ مَّسۡحُوۡرُوۡنَ ﴿٪۱۶﴾
verses.en: They would surely say, ‘Only our eyes are dazed; rather we are a bewitched people.’

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِی السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّزَیَّنّٰہَا لِلنّٰظِرِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۷﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We have, indeed, made mansions of stars in the heaven and have adorned it for beholders.

verses.ar: وَحَفِظۡنٰہَا مِنۡ کُلِّ شَیۡطٰنٍ رَّجِیۡمٍ ﴿ۙ۱۸﴾
verses.en: And We have protected it against every rejected satan.

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ اسۡتَرَقَ السَّمۡعَ فَاَتۡبَعَہٗ شِہَابٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: But if any one hears stealthily, there pursues him a bright flame.

verses.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰہَا وَاَلۡقَیۡنَا فِیۡہَا رَوَاسِیَ وَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِیۡہَا مِنۡ کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ مَّوۡزُوۡنٍ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: And the earth have We spread out, and set therein firm mountains and caused everything to grow therein in proper proportion.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَکُمۡ فِیۡہَا مَعَایِشَ وَمَنۡ لَّسۡتُمۡ لَہٗ بِرٰزِقِیۡنَ ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: And We have made for you therein means of livelihood, and also for all those for whom you do not provide.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَیۡءٍ اِلَّا عِنۡدَنَا خَزَآئِنُہٗ ۫ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُہٗۤ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: And there is not a thing but with Us are the treasures thereof and We send it not down except in a known measure.

verses.ar: وَاَرۡسَلۡنَا الرِّیٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَسۡقَیۡنٰکُمُوۡہُ ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ لَہٗ بِخٰزِنِیۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: And We send impregnating winds, then We send down water from the clouds, then We give it to you to drink; and you are not the ones to store it up.
w: then We give it to you to drink

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡیٖ وَنُمِیۡتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَ ﴿۲۴﴾
verses.en: And verily, it is We Who give life, and We Who cause death; and it is We Who are the sole Inheritor.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِیۡنَ مِنۡکُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَاۡخِرِیۡنَ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: And We do know those who go ahead among you and We do know those who lag behind.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّکَ ہُوَ یَحۡشُرُہُمۡ ؕ اِنَّہٗ حَکِیۡمٌ عَلِیۡمٌ ﴿٪۲۶﴾
verses.en: And surely, it is thy Lord Who will gather them together. Surely, He is Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿ۚ۲۷﴾
verses.en: [✲]And, surely, We created man from dry ringing clay, from black mud wrought into shape.

verses.ar: وَالۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنٰہُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ مِنۡ نَّارِ السَّمُوۡمِ ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: [✲]And the Jinn We had created before from the fire of hot wind.

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّکَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃِ اِنِّیۡ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: And remember when thy Lord said to the angels, ‘I am about to create man from dry ringing clay, from black mud wrought into shape;

verses.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّیۡتُہٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِیۡہِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِیۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَہٗ سٰجِدِیۡنَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: ‘So when I have fashioned him in perfection and have breathed into him of My Spirit, fall ye down in submission to him.’

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃُ کُلُّہُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۱﴾
verses.en: So the angels submitted, all of them together,

verses.ar: اِلَّاۤ اِبۡلِیۡسَ ؕ اَبٰۤی اَنۡ یَّکُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِیۡنَ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: Except Iblis; he refused to be among those who submit.

verses.ar: قَالَ یٰۤـاِبۡلِیۡسُ مَا لَکَ اَلَّا تَکُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِیۡنَ ﴿۳۳﴾
verses.en: God said, ‘O Iblis, what is the matter with thee that thou wouldst not be among those who submit?’

verses.ar: قَالَ لَمۡ اَکُنۡ لِّاَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَہٗ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: He answered, ‘I am not going to submit to man whom Thou hast created from dry ringing clay, from black mud wrought into shape.’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡہَا فَاِنَّکَ رَجِیۡمٌ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: God said, ‘Then get out hence, for, surely, thou art rejected.

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَیۡکَ اللَّعۡنَۃَ اِلٰی یَوۡمِ الدِّیۡنِ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: ‘And, surely, on thee shall be My curse till the Day of Judgment.’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِیۡۤ اِلٰی یَوۡمِ یُبۡعَثُوۡنَ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, then grant me respite till the day when they shall be raised.’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّکَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۸﴾
verses.en: God said, ‘Thou art of those that are granted respite,

verses.ar: اِلٰی یَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ ﴿۳۹﴾
verses.en: ‘Till the day of the appointed time.’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَغۡوَیۡتَنِیۡ لَاُزَیِّنَنَّ لَہُمۡ فِی الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَاُغۡوِیَنَّہُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۰﴾
verses.en: He answered, ‘My Lord, since Thou hast adjudged me as lost, I will surely make evil appear beautiful to them on the earth, and I will surely lead them all astray,
w: Thou hast adjudged me as lost
I will surely make evil appear beautiful
and I will surely lead them astray

verses.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَکَ مِنۡہُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِیۡنَ ﴿۴۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Except Thy chosen servants from among them.’

verses.ar: قَالَ ہٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَیَّ مُسۡتَقِیۡمٌ ﴿۴۲﴾
verses.en: God said, ‘This is a path leading straight to Me.

verses.ar: اِنَّ عِبَادِیۡ لَیۡسَ لَکَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَکَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِیۡنَ ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: ‘Surely, thou shalt have no power over My servants, except such of the erring ones as choose to follow thee.’

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ جَہَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُہُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿۟ۙ۴۴﴾
verses.en: And, surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.

verses.ar: لَہَا سَبۡعَۃُ اَبۡوَابٍ ؕ لِکُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنۡہُمۡ جُزۡءٌ مَّقۡسُوۡمٌ ﴿٪۴۵﴾
verses.en: It has seven gates: and each gate has a portion of them allotted to it.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ فِیۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُیُوۡنٍ ﴿ؕ۴۶﴾
verses.en: Verily, the righteous will be placed amid gardens and fountains.

verses.ar: اُدۡخُلُوۡہَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: ‘Enter therein with peace, in safety.’

verses.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِہِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ اِخۡوَانًا عَلٰی سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِیۡنَ ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We shall remove whatever of rancour may be in their breasts so that they will become as brothers seated on thrones, facing one another.
w: so that they will become as brothers

verses.ar: لَا یَمَسُّہُمۡ فِیۡہَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا ہُمۡ مِّنۡہَا بِمُخۡرَجِیۡنَ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: Fatigue shall not touch them there, nor shall they ever be ejected therefrom.

verses.ar: نَبِّیٴۡ عِبَادِیۡۤ اَنِّیۡۤ اَنَا الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِیۡمُ ﴿ۙ۵۰﴾
verses.en: Tell My servants that I am surely the One Most Forgiving, the Merciful;

verses.ar: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِیۡ ہُوَ الۡعَذَابُ الۡاَلِیۡمُ ﴿۵۱﴾
verses.en: And also that My punishment is the grievous punishment.

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡہُمۡ عَنۡ ضَیۡفِ اِبۡرٰہِیۡمَ ﴿ۘ۵۲﴾
verses.en: And tell them about Abraham’s guests.

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَیۡہِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا ؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنۡکُمۡ وَجِلُوۡنَ ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: When they entered in unto him and said, ‘Peace,’ he answered, ‘Verily, we feel afraid of you.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا تَوۡجَلۡ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُکَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِیۡمٍ ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Fear not, we give thee glad tidings of a son who shall be endowed with knowledge.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اَبَشَّرۡتُمُوۡنِیۡ عَلٰۤی اَنۡ مَّسَّنِیَ الۡکِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوۡنَ ﴿۵۵﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘Do you give me the glad tidings in spite of the fact that old age has overtaken me? Of what then do you give me the glad tidings?’
w: do you give me the glad tidings
do you give me the glad tidings

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَشَّرۡنٰکَ بِالۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَکُنۡ مِّنَ الۡقٰنِطِیۡنَ ﴿۵۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]They said, ‘We have, indeed, given thee glad tidings in truth; be not therefore of those who despair.’
w: We have, indeed, given thee glad tidings

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَنۡ یَّقۡنَطُ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَۃِ رَبِّہٖۤ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّوۡنَ ﴿۵۷﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘And who can despair of the mercy of his Lord save those who go astray?’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُکُمۡ اَیُّہَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿۵۸﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘What now is your business, O ye messengers?’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰی قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۵۹﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘We have been sent unto a guilty people

verses.ar: اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ ؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوۡہُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۶۰﴾
verses.en: ‘Excepting the family of Lot. Them we shall save all,

verses.ar: اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَہٗ قَدَّرۡنَاۤ ۙ اِنَّہَا لَمِنَ الۡغٰبِرِیۡنَ ﴿٪۶۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Except his wife. We surmise that she shall be of those who remain behind.’

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اٰلَ لُوۡطِ ۣالۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۶۲﴾
verses.en: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّکُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡکَرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۳﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘Verily, you are a party of strangers.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ جِئۡنٰکَ بِمَا کَانُوۡا فِیۡہِ یَمۡتَرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۴﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Nay, but we have come to thee with that about which they doubted.

verses.ar: وَاَتَیۡنٰکَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ ﴿۶۵﴾
verses.en: ‘And we have come to thee with the truth, and surely we are truthful.
w: and we have come to thee

verses.ar: فَاَسۡرِ بِاَہۡلِکَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّیۡلِ وَاتَّبِعۡ اَدۡبَارَہُمۡ وَلَا یَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡکُمۡ اَحَدٌ وَّامۡضُوۡا حَیۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۶﴾
verses.en: ‘So go forth with thy family in the latter part of the night, and follow thou in their rear. And let none of you look back, and now proceed to where you are commanded.’

verses.ar: وَقَضَیۡنَاۤ اِلَیۡہِ ذٰلِکَ الۡاَمۡرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوۡعٌ مُّصۡبِحِیۡنَ ﴿۶۷﴾
verses.en: And We communicated to him this decree that the root of them was to be cut off by the morning.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ اَہۡلُ الۡمَدِیۡنَۃِ یَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۸﴾
verses.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ ضَیۡفِیۡ فَلَا تَفۡضَحُوۡنِ ﴿ۙ۶۹﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘These are my guests, so put me not to shame;

verses.ar: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰہَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ ﴿۷۰﴾
verses.en: ‘And fear Allah and disgrace me not.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اَوَلَمۡ نَنۡہَکَ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۷۱﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Did we not forbid thee to entertain all sorts of people?’

verses.ar: قَالَ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ بَنٰتِیۡۤ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۷۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]He said, ‘These are my daughters if you must do something.’

verses.ar: لَعَمۡرُکَ اِنَّہُمۡ لَفِیۡ سَکۡرَتِہِمۡ یَعۡمَہُوۡنَ ﴿۷۳﴾
verses.en: By thy life, these too in their mad intoxication are wandering in distraction —

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡہُمُ الصَّیۡحَۃُ مُشۡرِقِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۷۴﴾
verses.en: Then the punishment seized them at sunrise.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَالِیَہَا سَافِلَہَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ حِجَارَۃً مِّنۡ سِجِّیۡلٍ ﴿ؕ۷۵﴾
verses.en: We turned it upside down, and We rained upon them stones of clay.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِیۡنَ ﴿۷۶﴾
verses.en: Surely, in this are Signs for those who can read signs.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّہَا لَبِسَبِیۡلٍ مُّقِیۡمٍ ﴿۷۷﴾
verses.en: And it lies on a road that still exists.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۷۸﴾
verses.en: Surely, in this is a Sign for believers.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ کَانَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَیۡکَۃِ لَظٰلِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۷۹﴾
verses.en: And the People of the Wood too were surely wrongdoers.

verses.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡہُمۡ ۘ وَاِنَّہُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿ؕ٪۸۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]So We chastised them also. And they both lie on a manifest way.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ کَذَّبَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡحِجۡرِ الۡمُرۡسَلِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۱﴾
verses.en: And the People of the Hijr also did treat the Messengers as liars.

verses.ar: وَاٰتَیۡنٰہُمۡ اٰیٰتِنَا فَکَانُوۡا عَنۡہَا مُعۡرِضِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۲﴾
verses.en: And We gave them Our Signs, but they turned away from them.

verses.ar: وَکَانُوۡا یَنۡحِتُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُیُوۡتًا اٰمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۸۳﴾
verses.en: And they used to hew out houses in the mountains, in security.

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡہُمُ الصَّیۡحَۃُ مُصۡبِحِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۴﴾
verses.en: But the punishment seized them in the morning,

verses.ar: فَمَاۤ اَغۡنٰی عَنۡہُمۡ مَّا کَانُوۡا یَکۡسِبُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۸۵﴾
verses.en: And all that they had earned availed them not.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ ؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَۃَ لَاٰتِیَۃٌ فَاصۡفَحِ الصَّفۡحَ الۡجَمِیۡلَ ﴿۸۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two but in accordance with the requirements of wisdom; and the Hour is sure to come. So turn away from them in a comely manner.
w: in accordance with the requirements of wisdom

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّکَ ہُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ ﴿۸۷﴾
verses.en: Verily, it is thy Lord Who is the Great Creator, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَیۡنٰکَ سَبۡعًا مِّنَ الۡمَثَانِیۡ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنَ الۡعَظِیۡمَ ﴿۸۸﴾
verses.en: And We have, indeed, given thee the seven oft-repeated verses, and the Great Qur’an.

verses.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَیۡنَیۡکَ اِلٰی مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِہٖۤ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡہُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَیۡہِمۡ وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَکَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۸۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]Stretch not thy eyes towards what We have bestowed on some classes of them to enjoy for a short time, and grieve not over them; and lower thy wing of mercy for the believers.
w: We have bestowed to enjoy for a short time

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ اِنِّیۡۤ اَنَا النَّذِیۡرُ الۡمُبِیۡنُ ﴿ۚ۹۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And say, ‘I am, indeed, a plain Warner.’

verses.ar: کَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَی الۡمُقۡتَسِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]Because We have decided to send down punishment on those who have formed themselves into groups against thee;
w: those who have formed themselves into groups against thee

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ جَعَلُوا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ عِضِیۡنَ ﴿۹۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]Who have pronounced the Qur’an to be so many lies;

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّکَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّہُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۳﴾
verses.en: So by thy Lord, We will, surely, question them all

verses.ar: عَمَّا کَانُوۡا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿ٙ۹۴﴾
verses.en: Concerning that which they used to do.

verses.ar: فَاصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ ﴿۹۵﴾
verses.en: So declare openly that with which thou art commanded and turn aside from those who ascribe partners to God.

verses.ar: اِنَّا کَفَیۡنٰکَ الۡمُسۡتَہۡزِءِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۶﴾
verses.en: We will, surely, suffice thee against those who mock:

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ یَجۡعَلُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰہِ اِلٰہًا اٰخَرَ ۚ فَسَوۡفَ یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿۹۷﴾
verses.en: Who set up another God with Allah, but soon shall they come to know.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ اَنَّکَ یَضِیۡقُ صَدۡرُکَ بِمَا یَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۸﴾
verses.en: And, indeed, We know that thy bosom becomes straitened because of what they say.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّکَ وَکُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۹﴾
verses.en: But glorify thy Lord praising Him, and be of those who prostrate themselves before Him.

verses.ar: وَاعۡبُدۡ رَبَّکَ حَتّٰی یَاۡتِیَکَ الۡیَقِیۡنُ ﴿٪۱۰۰﴾
verses.en: And continue worshipping thy Lord, till death comes to thee.
